LIVE_PROCESS_LOGIC.note: Live process does NOT run resync-checkpoint code. Profile/watcher signal path modules were NOT modified after process start → live signal profile contract matches those files on disk at start.

profile_kind.primary: Volume Profile value area (ClickHouse build_profile) on last completed UTC window
profile_kind.tpo: Optional TPO presence profile from public trades with 1-minute marks; falls back to volume VAH/VAL
profile_kind.watcher_selection: nearest edge by |mid-edge|/mid*10000 among ALL edges; UPPER if kind endswith VAH else LOWER if VAL
profile_kind.signal_relevant_edge_observed: TPO_VAH or TPO_VAL (equal to VOL when volume_proxy_fallback)
profile_kind.live_update_during_event: PROFILE_UPDATE_DURING_CAPTURE deferred; frozen_edges used until event end

profile_window.type: Rolling last-completed UTC-aligned window (NOT classic RTH session, NOT daily composite)
profile_window.causal_cutoff: window end; trades with ts >= end excluded; completeness=completed_window_only

what_30m_means.profile_window_minutes: YES — completed lookback window for VAH/VAL (env OB_V3_FULL_OB_FR_PROFILE_WINDOW_MIN default 30)
what_30m_means.tpo_bracket_duration: NO — when TPO succeeds, marks are 1-minute presence (tpo_bracket_presence_1m_causal), not 30m brackets
what_30m_means.candle_timeframe: NO — not a kline interval; public trades densified into price bins
what_30m_means.meta_field_bracket_minutes: stores profile_window_minutes (naming is window length, not TPO bracket)

tpo_bracket.intended_when_trades_available: 1m presence marks inside the 30m completed window
tpo_bracket.config_source: hardcoded int(ts.timestamp())//60 in profiles.py; window from profile_window_minutes
tpo_bracket.live_value_for_signals: volume_proxy_fallback — TPO edges cloned from volume VA

update_frequency.edge_recalc: on successful poll when not capturing; deferred during capture

trigger_zone.arm_meaning: dist<=50 and not IN → ARMED / Full-OB keep-alive path; NOT the CROSS_IN threshold
trigger_zone.entry_meaning: zone IN when dist<=20; CROSS_IN = transition into IN from outside IN
trigger_zone.rearm_meaning: zone OUT when dist>=75; after cooldown, REARMED only from OUT
trigger_zone.hysteresis: IN<=20, OUT>=75, APPROACH in between; arm uses 50 inside APPROACH band
trigger_zone.bootstrap: start already IN without saw_outside → BOOTSTRAP_ALREADY_IN_EDGE_ZONE; current manager refuses persistent capture
trigger_zone.note_arm_unused_in_classify_zone_state_b: classify_zone_state accepts arm_bps but only uses capture_bps and disarm_bps for zone labels

phase_e_answer.Profilart: Volume Profile VA (+ TPO marks when available; live signals used volume_proxy_fallback so TPO_* == VOL_*)
phase_e_answer.Profilfenster: Last completed 30-minute UTC-aligned rolling window (ProfileWindow anchor_mode=composite)
phase_e_answer.TPO-Bracket: 1-minute presence when TPO path succeeds; live events fell back to volume VA (no separate 30m TPO bracket)
phase_e_answer.Kerzen-Timeframe-Abh\u00e4ngigkeit: None — not driven by candle TF
phase_e_answer.Session: UTC clock windows e.g. 07:30–08:00; not exchange RTH session
phase_e_answer.Aktualisierung: Poll every 20s; freeze edges at CROSS_IN / event start
phase_e_answer.Signalrelevante Kante: Nearest *VAH/*VAL (observed TPO_VAH or TPO_VAL) at <=20 bps entry
